## Pull request overview

Upgrades the monorepo’s `@objectstack/*` dependency set from `^3.2.5` to `^3.2.6`, keeping all internal packages/apps/examples aligned and updating the lockfile + changelog accordingly.

**Changes:**
- Bumped `@objectstack/*` versions to `^3.2.6` across 13 `package.json` files.
- Regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml` to reflect resolved `3.2.6` artifacts and peer ranges.
- Added an Unreleased changelog entry documenting the upgrade.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 14 out of 15 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `package.json` | Updates root-level `@objectstack/*` devDependencies/dependencies to `^3.2.6`. |
| `pnpm-lock.yaml` | Lockfile refresh to resolve `@objectstack/*` to `3.2.6` and update snapshots. |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | Documents the `@objectstack v3.2.6` upgrade under Unreleased. |
| `apps/console/package.json` | Aligns console app `@objectstack/*` devDependencies to `^3.2.6`. |
| `packages/core/package.json` | Updates `@objectstack/spec` to `^3.2.6`. |
| `packages/types/package.json` | Updates `@objectstack/spec` to `^3.2.6`. |
| `packages/react/package.json` | Updates `@objectstack/spec` to `^3.2.6`. |
| `packages/data-objectstack/package.json` | Updates `@objectstack/client` to `^3.2.6`. |
| `packages/plugin-map/package.json` | Updates `@objectstack/spec` to `^3.2.6`. |
| `packages/plugin-gantt/package.json` | Updates `@objectstack/spec` to `^3.2.6`. |
| `packages/plugin-timeline/package.json` | Updates `@objectstack/spec` to `^3.2.6`. |
| `examples/todo/package.json` | Updates `@objectstack/client`, `@objectstack/spec`, and `@objectstack/cli` to `^3.2.6`. |
| `examples/msw-todo/package.json` | Updates `@objectstack/*` runtime/dev deps used by the MSW example to `^3.2.6`. |
| `examples/kitchen-sink/package.json` | Updates `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/cli` to `^3.2.6`. |
| `examples/crm/package.json` | Updates `@objectstack/*` deps/devDeps used by the CRM example to `^3.2.6`. |
